articles.title: Jupiter's Giant Moon Ganymede Has a Secret Heater Inside!
articles.summary: Ganymede, the biggest moon in our solar system, might be warming up from the inside. That heat could explain its mysterious magnetic field—and it's still happening today!

articles.title: Venus Has Giant Mystery Rings—And Scientists Just Got a 3D Peek!
articles.summary: Venus is covered with huge circular patterns called coronae. New 3D maps show they might be formed by hot stuff rising from deep inside the planet—and Venus could be more active than we thought!

articles.title: Splashy Showdowns: Olympians and Rising Stars Battle in London Pool!
articles.summary: The final day of the AP Race London International is here! Olympians like Daniel Wiffen and James Guy face off against fast newcomers in events from the 800m free to the 50m fly. Who will take home the gold?
